title: '22 built-in agents' count is dead wrong — base engine now ships zero
reality: v2.3.0 moved essentially all agents into optional downloadable packages. Verified upstream: `BUILT_IN_AGENT_MANIFESTS` in packages/shared/src/features/agents/agent-registry.generated.ts is now an EMPTY array, and fresh installs contain no optional agents (2.3.0 changelog: 'Fresh installs now contain no optional agents'; base Engine shed 25,000+ lines of optional agent/map/call/table-game code). All 21 of agents.md's listed built-ins except about-me-keeper are now packages in the Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents catalog (director, knowledge-retrieval, knowledge-router, html, echo-chamber, combat, prose-guardian, continuity, world-state, character-tracker, custom-tracker, persona-stats, quest, expression, background, illustrator, lorebook-keeper, card-evolution-auditor, spotify, cyoa, haptic). `BUILT_IN_AGENT_IDS` survives only as canonical id constants.
fix: Rewrite the 'Built-In Agents' section (agents.md lines 51-83): replace 'There are 22 built-in agents' with an explanation that as of v2.3.0 the base engine ships NO agents; the former built-ins are official downloadable packages (keep the per-phase list as a catalog of official packages, noting each is install-on-demand). Note BUILT_IN_AGENT_MANIFESTS is now empty and BUILT_IN_AGENT_IDS persists only for compatibility.

title: about-me-keeper is now retired, not the '22nd built-in'
reality: Verified upstream: `about-me-keeper` is the first entry in `RETIRED_BUILT_IN_AGENT_IDS` (packages/shared/src/types/agent.ts). The 2.3.0 changelog and Marinara-Agents README state Conversation's About Me profile and the `update_about_me` tool 'remain built into the Engine and are not downloadable agents' / 'are not agents and must not be published in this catalog'. Additionally 2.3.2 moved Conversation About Me drafting from per-editor AI Write controls to Professor Mari, which can inspect a character/persona and save directly to the About Me field.
fix: Delete the `about-me-keeper` bullet (agents.md line 83) from the agent list and add it to the 'Retired — don't reference these' note (line 55). Document instead that About Me / update_about_me is a built-in Engine feature (not an agent, not a package), and that About Me drafting is now done via Professor Mari (2.3.2), not per-editor AI Write.

title: Missing: Download Agents library and package management UI
reality: v2.3.0 added a responsive full-page Agents → Download Agents library for installing, reading about, updating, and uninstalling official capability packages, with installed/uninstalled groupings ordered Writer, Tracker, Misc Agents; Card Evolution is classified Writer, Hierarchical Maps Tracker; creator artwork with Agents-star fallback; desktop opens full-page libraries beside the sidebar, mobile full-screen. Install All / Uninstall All controls run a safe sequential queue with progress, partial-failure reporting, catalog refresh, and confirmation before bulk removal. 2.3.2 (#3676) added Conversation/Roleplay/Game compatibility badges and catalog search by supported mode. 2.3.3 (#3736) removed redundant Maps/Conversation Game kind badges from catalog details.
fix: Add a new top-level section 'Downloadable Agents (v2.3)' to agents.md covering: Agents → Download Agents library, Writer/Tracker/Misc groupings, install/update/uninstall lifecycle (some server-runtime packages require restart), Install All / Uninstall All, and mode-compatibility badges/search.

title: Missing: Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents catalog repo and 29-package catalog
reality: v2.3.0 published first-party downloadable agents in github.com/Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents as individually verified packages. Verified from that repo's README: 29 first-party packages for Engine v2.3.0+ — 6 Writer (card-evolution-auditor, continuity, knowledge-retrieval, knowledge-router, director, prose-guardian), 8 Tracker (background, character-tracker, custom-tracker, expression, hierarchical-maps, persona-stats, quest, world-state), 15 Misc (eightball, chess, combat, conversation-calls/'Calls', cyoa, echo-chamber, haptic, illustrator, html, lorebook-keeper, spotify/'Music DJ', poker, rock-paper-scissors, tic-tac-toe, uno). Package trust: schema validation, SHA-256 checksums, path/hash/size checks, atomic install into the data dir, offline availability. Professor Mari's prompts carry a canonical 29-package catalog summary (2.3.0). Full per-package docs live in the Engine's docs/agents/built-in-agents.md ('Downloadable Agents Reference', confirmed to exist).
fix: In the new Downloadable Agents section, name the Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents repo as the official catalog source, list the 29 packages with their Writer/Tracker/Misc categories and package ids (note 'spotify' is Music DJ's package id, 'conversation-calls' is Calls), and point to docs/agents/built-in-agents.md as the upstream reference.

title: Missing: per-major catalog lanes and startup auto-upgrade
reality: 2.3.3 (#3712) added compatibility-aware catalog selection: each Engine major installs and updates only from its matching catalog lane (Marinara-Agents README confirms catalog/v2/catalog.json for Engine 2, catalog/v3/ for Engine 3, catalog/catalog.json as legacy v2 alias). 2.3.1 added startup auto-upgrade: installed official packages check the catalog during server startup and automatically upgrade to the newest compatible version before their runtimes activate; offline/incompatible/missing/failed updates keep the previously installed version, and verified server-runtime failures roll back automatically. 2.3.3 additionally quarantines incompatible runtimes (e.g. Hierarchical Maps 1.0.x, the `t.select is not a function` crash) before their adapters load; catalog HTTP failures now report actual status instead of claiming an internet outage (2.3.2 #3706/#3707), and installed agents remain usable offline.
fix: Document in the Downloadable Agents section: per-Engine-major catalog lanes (2.3.3 #3712), startup auto-upgrade with offline fallback and rollback (2.3.1), quarantine of incompatible package versions, and offline behavior of installed packages.

title: Missing packages that were never in agents.md: Hierarchical Maps, Calls, six Conversation games
reality: v2.3.0 moved Hierarchical Maps, Conversation audio/video calls, UNO, Chess, Poker, 8-Ball Pool, Tic-Tac-Toe, and Rock-Paper-Scissors into optional packages with package-owned server runtimes. Hierarchical Maps is a Tracker agent enableable in Roleplay and during/after Game creation; its controls live inside its entry in Chat Settings → Agents (2.3.2 #3679). 'Conversation Calls' was renamed user-facing to 'Calls' in 2.3.2 (#3676; package id conversation-calls preserved); Local Whisper is now a Calls-owned download — uninstalling Calls removes downloaded Whisper models and their selection (2.3.0). The six table games are Conversation feature packages exposing slash commands (/uno, /chess, /poker, /8ball, /tictactoe, /rps); they appear in the Commands controls, NOT as per-chat pipeline agents (2.3.0 fixed section), and installed games activate/deactivate their commands without an Engine restart while route-bearing packages retain the restart path (2.3.2 #3699). Calls package v1.0.4 stopped persisting a hardcoded assistant reply on generation failure and no longer requires provider-native JSON mode (#3685).
fix: Add entries for Hierarchical Maps, Calls (conversation-calls), and the six Conversation game packages to the agents.md catalog listing, noting the games/Calls are Conversation feature packages surfaced through Commands rather than the agent pipeline, the Calls↔Whisper ownership, and the Maps settings location.

title: 'Enable Agents' master toggle and cross-mode custom-agent rules undocumented
reality: v2.3 chats have a per-chat 'Enable Agents' master switch. The v2.3 capability migration preserves it so upgrading cannot silently reactivate agents (2.3.0 #3669); 2.3.3 made Hierarchical Maps obey it across Roleplay and Game UI, prompt generation, lorebook previews, retries, tracker patches, session carryover, and checkpoints. 2.3.2 (#3692) allows selected CUSTOM agents to run in Conversation, Roleplay, AND Game chats whenever Enable Agents is on, while per-mode availability rules still apply to official packages — which supersedes agents.md's 'Game Mode & mode gating' framing that modeAllowlist gates everything.
fix: Add an 'Enable Agents master toggle' subsection: per-chat master switch semantics, migration preservation (#3669), Maps compliance (2.3.3), and update the 'Game Mode & mode gating' section to state custom agents now run in all three modes when Enable Agents is on (#3692) while modeAllowlist-style gating applies to official packages.

title: Missing: capability API 1.3 host services for package authors
reality: 2.3.2 (#3690) added capability API 1.3 host services for downloadable packages: safe model routing, persistence, history/checkpoints, resources, logging, transactions, client contribution loading, and visible readiness/retry states. 2.3.0 also introduced 'small validated capability registries and compatibility bridges' in the base engine, and 2.3.0's fixed section notes capability-owned file-table/column objects resolve through the Engine's registered schema names (#3647). Agents.md's custom-agent section only covers the old in-engine custom-agent schema and capability IDs.
fix: Add a short 'Capability packages (developer view)' subsection noting capability API 1.3 host services (#3690, 2.3.2) and that package server runtimes access storage via registered schema names — relevant for anyone building a distributable agent package rather than an in-app custom agent.

title: Illustrator entry stale: now an optional package gating commands and Gallery
reality: Illustrator is an optional Misc package (v2.3.0). Until installed: image/video generation settings and /illustrate and /selfie commands are hidden; Gallery actions (Illustrate, Selfie, Storyboard, Video, Animate, Background) require Illustrator installed and enabled for that chat in every mode. Selfie configuration was renamed 'Illustrator Settings' inside Chat Settings → Agents; the Connections 'Illustrator' defaults category was renamed 'Images'; Game setup's 'Visual Generation' was renamed Illustrator and appears only when installed (all 2.3.0). 2.3.2: a fix made package-owned commands (e.g. Selfies) appear as soon as the agent is installed.
fix: Update the `illustrator` bullet (agents.md line 77): mark it as a downloadable Misc package, note the /illustrate + /selfie commands and all Gallery generation actions require it installed+enabled per chat, and note the renames (Illustrator Settings in Chat Settings → Agents; Connections category now 'Images').

title: Music DJ (spotify) entry stale: optional package behind Music Player toggle
reality: Music DJ is an optional Misc package (package id `spotify`). v2.3.0: the always-available Music Player toggle shows 'Download Music DJ Agent to configure' guidance with a direct Download Agents action when Music DJ is not installed; stale Spotify/YouTube/Custom player controls were replaced. Catalog README: plays scene-matched music through Spotify, YouTube, or local Game Assets.
fix: Update the `spotify` bullet (agents.md line 80): mark as downloadable package; note the Music Player toggle remains built-in but requires the Music DJ package for configuration, and that local Game Assets is now a supported music source alongside Spotify/YouTube.

title: UI Location section stale: install-gated sections and Download Agents links
reality: v2.3.0: agent sections, settings, and package-owned command toggles appear only for agents that are actually installed; Chat Settings → Agents remains available in Conversation/Roleplay/Game with no optional agents installed (built-in Conversation commands stay configurable); empty Roleplay/Game sections and the empty setup-wizard Agents step link directly to Download Agents; uninstalling an agent now removes its card from the open Agents sidebar immediately; downloaded package artwork is applied to installed agents in the sidebar. 2.3.2 (#3679) moved Hierarchical Maps controls inside its Chat Settings → Agents entry.
fix: Update the 'UI Location' section (agents.md lines 235-241): describe install-gating of agent sections/toggles, empty-state links to Download Agents, immediate sidebar refresh on uninstall, and the full-page library layout (desktop side-by-side, mobile full-screen).

title: Source-of-truth pointers need re-scoping to the package split
reality: The cited files still exist upstream (agent-executor.ts, agent-pipeline.ts, agent.schema.ts, agent-prompts.ts, agent-registry.generated.ts all return 200 on main), but v2.3.0 removed 25,000+ lines of agent implementation from the base engine; feature code now lives in the Marinara-Agents repo (e.g. Hierarchical Maps source under packages/hierarchical-maps/src/engine/), BUILT_IN_AGENT_MANIFESTS is empty, and the authoritative per-package documentation is the Engine's docs/agents/built-in-agents.md plus each package's manifest.json in Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents.
fix: Amend the 'Source of truth' line (agents.md line 7) and the prompt-template notes (lines 85, 193): add Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents (packages/<id>/manifest.json, package-owned src) and docs/agents/built-in-agents.md as sources for packaged agents, and caveat that agent-registry.generated.ts's manifest list is now empty because feature code ships in packages.

title: Missing: v2.3 migration behavior and known migration bug
reality: Existing installations migrate their agents and chat feature selections to packages without losing settings, runtime data, or history (2.3.0); migration downloads matching packages once (catalog README); the migration is restart-safe/idempotent (#3670). Known bug: the v2.3.2 capability migration wrongly selected Hierarchical Maps in every Roleplay/Visual Novel/Game chat; 2.3.3 (#3723) ships a one-time correction removing only accidental selections from chats without map definitions/snapshots.
fix: Add a brief 'Upgrading to v2.3' note to agents.md: agents/selections migrate automatically and restart-safely; users on 2.3.2 who saw Maps auto-selected everywhere should update to 2.3.3 which auto-corrects it (#3723).

title: Tuning advice stale: agent availability now depends on installation
reality: agents.md's tuning/recommendation framing ('All agents are disabled by default. Users enable only what they need', line 5) predates the package split: in v2.3.x an agent must first be INSTALLED from Download Agents, then enabled per chat under the Enable Agents master toggle. Recommendation logic for skill users ('minimum viable set') now naturally extends to 'install only what you need' — the catalog README makes this the design intent ('Marinara Engine starts lightweight').
fix: Update the intro (agents.md lines 3-5) to the two-step model: install (Download Agents) then enable (per chat, under the Enable Agents master toggle); keep the minimum-viable-set advice and add 'and uninstall unused packages to reclaim disk/startup cost'.
